findings.claim: Q3 2026 財報（2026-11-03）公司將 FY2026 營收 guidance 上調至 $4.15–4.20B、Adjusted EBITDA 上調至 $790–800M；搜尋未見 2026 年下調。
findings.source: Grab Form 6-K Q3 2026 earnings press release (SEC)
findings.excerpt: Full-year 2026 Group Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance raised to $4.15 - $4.20 billion and $790 - $800 million, respectively.

findings.source: Grab Form 6-K Q2 2026 earnings press release (SEC)
findings.excerpt: We are raising our full-year 2026 guidance to $4.10 billion to $4.15 billion in Group revenue and $720 million to $740 million in Adjusted EBITDA

findings.claim: MarketBeat 10 月底：分析師共識評級 Buy、共識目標價 $6.01；同文股價約 $2.79，接近一年低點 $2.74（價格僅為來源字面，現價以 numbers.price_at_dd 為準）。
findings.source: MarketBeat, Upcoming: Grab expected to post earnings on Monday
findings.excerpt: analysts maintain a consensus "Buy" rating and a $6.01 price target

findings.claim: Investing.com 目標價分布：平均 5.82 美元、高 8 美元、低 4.6 美元（日期未標，as_of 為估計）。
findings.excerpt: average 12-month price target for Grab Holdings is 5.820 USD, with a high estimate of 8 USD and a low estimate of 4.6 USD

findings.claim: 個別券商 5 月調降目標價：Mizuho $7→$6（outperform）、JPMorgan 降至 $5.80（overweight）；StoneX 2026-09-16 維持 $7 買進。

note: Q3 發布前共識（MarketBeat：Q3 EPS 0.02／營收 $1.05B、FY EPS 0.14；Benzinga Q3 營收 $1.10B）與本次 guidance 上調之落差、以及 Q3 後的目標價修正，本軸未查到來源；各聚合站目標價互相不一致且多為 Q3 前資料。
